cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN586, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, gate 213, information G received, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方586，从武汉飞往广州，213号停机位，收到通播G，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN586, gate 213, information G, destination Guangzhou, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方586，,213号停机位，通播G，目的地广州，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN586, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, when airborne contact departure 119.7, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系119.7，应答机3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, contact 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，按照LKO01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系119.7，应答机3115，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Now you are pushback with the engines running, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你在发动机启动情况下推出，请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方586，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，经由Z4，A3，A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3，A，在跑道36右外等待，南方586。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东部有人和设备运行。

cards.audioText: [You encountered the wind shear between 200m to 400m, report the situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变，向管制员报告此情况]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN586, we encountered wind shear between 200m to 400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，南方586，在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变。

cards.audioText: [Now you are cruising at 8000m, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在巡航在8000米，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联系]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, maintaining 8000m, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，正保持在8000米，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText: CSN586, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position report.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，广州区调，雷达识别，省略位置报。

cards.audioText: [As you were descending to 4200m, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你下降到4200米时，你执行了TCAS RA 爬升机动，将情况报告管制员]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, we executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver while descending to 4200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，我们在下降到4200米时，执行了TCAS RA 爬升机动。

cards.audioText: [Now the conflicting traffic is clear, resume descend. Report the situation to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在与冲突航空器已解除冲突，恢复下降。将此情况报告给管制员]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, conflicted traffic clear, resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，与冲突航空器已解除冲突，恢复下降。

cards.audioText: [Now you are established on the ILS approach runway 36R, tell the controller you cannot see PAPI light.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在建立了ILS进近，跑道36右，告诉管制员，你看不到PAPI灯]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN586, ILS established, runway 36R, PAPI light not in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方586，建立ILS进近，跑道36右，看不到PAPI灯。

cards.audioText: CSN586, cleared to land, PAPI light is out of service.
[Ask for follow me car after landing.]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN586, request a follow me car after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方586，落地后，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: The follow me car will wait for you on the taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 引导车将在滑行道A等你。
